notes: Fixes notification card borders: new notifications keep their reminder color during the current visit, while notifications below “Last seen here” use gray borders.

en: Fixes notification card borders: new notifications keep their reminder color during the current visit, while notifications below “Last seen here” use gray borders.
zh: 修复通知卡片边框：本次新增通知在查看期间保持对应彩色，“上次看到这里”下方的历史通知保持灰色。
es: Corrige los bordes de las notificaciones: las nuevas conservan su color durante la visita actual y las anteriores, bajo “Última visita”, usan bordes grises.
